from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    hr = next((r for r in range(h) if all(grid[r][c] == 2 for c in range(w))), None)
    if hr is not None:
        pts = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != bg and grid[r][c] != 2]
        if not pts: return out
        r0, r1 = min(r for r,c in pts), max(r for r,c in pts)
        c0, c1 = min(c for r,c in pts), max(c for r,c in pts)
        if r1 < hr:
            dr = hr - 1 - r1
            sr, er = r0, r1
            dest0 = r0 + dr
            stripe = dest0 - 1
        else:
            dr = hr + 1 - r0
            sr, er = r0, r1
            dest0 = r0 + dr
            stripe = dest0 + (r1-r0) + 1
        patch = [grid[r][c0:c1+1] for r in range(sr, er+1)]
        for r in range(sr, er+1):
            for c in range(c0,c1+1): out[r][c] = bg
        for i,row in enumerate(patch): out[dest0+i][c0:c1+1] = row[:]
        if 0 <= stripe < h: out[stripe] = [8]*w
        return out
    vc = next((c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 2 for r in range(h))), None)
    if vc is not None:
        pts = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != bg and grid[r][c] != 2]
        if not pts: return out
        r0,r1 = min(r for r,c in pts),max(r for r,c in pts)
        c0,c1 = min(c for r,c in pts),max(c for r,c in pts)
        if c1 < vc:
            dc = vc - 1 - c1
            destc = c0 + dc
            stripe = destc - 1
        else:
            dc = vc + 1 - c0
            destc = c0 + dc
            stripe = destc + (c1-c0) + 1
        patch = [grid[r][c0:c1+1] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
        for r in range(r0,r1+1):
            for c in range(c0,c1+1): out[r][c] = bg
        for i,row in enumerate(patch): out[r0+i][destc:destc+(c1-c0+1)] = row[:]
        if 0 <= stripe < w:
            for r in range(h): out[r][stripe] = 8
    return out
